mutants.name: invert-exit-code
mutants.why: return 1 on zero failures and 0 on failures inverts the entire gate signal; t1 expects exit 1 on failure

mutants.name: wrong-files-deposited-header
mutants.why: changing the ### Files Deposited header breaks the round-trip through _extract_agent_declared_deposits; t7 tests the synthesis formula
mutants.anchor: result_text = "### Files Deposited\n" + "".join(f"- `{p}`\n" for p in deposits)
mutants.replacement: result_text = "### Deposited Files\n" + "".join(f"- `{p}`\n" for p in deposits)

mutants.name: warn-sets-exit-code
mutants.why: WARN lines must never affect the exit code; setting return to 1 on any warn line would break t8
mutants.replacement: return 1 if failures or warn_lines else 0

mutants.name: drop-generic-cap
mutants.why: removing the >25 generic cap means all files are listed; t9 expects the (generic, N files) form

mutants.name: drop-one-gate-from-tuple
mutants.why: GATES must be the exact 5-tuple in order; dropping one gate breaks the identity check in t6

mutants.name: precheck-constant-zero
mutants.why: printing PRECHECK: 0 failure(s) regardless of actual failures masks all gate results; t1 expects 1 failure(s)
